**Author**: gen-physicist (generated by /rclab-plan per-wave swarm)

## Wave 2 Summary

Wave 2 is the keystone-lever wave of the M_KK-keystone structural-support session. The investigation-distillation campaign's master diagnosis — *sign-PASS / magnitude-FAIL is the rank-1 M_KK weight seen from every downstream consumer* (`_cross-investigation-synthesis.md §5` headline 1) — localizes the framework's whole dimensionful weakness to ONE object: the §VII.BS rank-1-PROVEN single imported weight `w = M_KK` propagating into every dimensionful prediction via `O = w·Ô`. W2 promotes the three highest-EVOI levers on that diagnosis plus the three HIGH-tier magnitude deciders, all from investigation-track builds (inv-10/11/12/13) into permanent `session-110` gates.

**Carry-forward source.** S109's forward-compute queue is EMPTY; the S110 scope is the investigation promotion-triage (`session-110-context.md`). Every W2 gate is a SESSION-PROMOTION of an investigation result: the substrate physics is computed on the investigation track, and per `gate-verdicts.md §"Investigation-Track Canonical Path"` (track-local boundary), an investigation result enters the permanent index ONLY when re-computed under a `session-N` gate. W2's gates re-run under `s110_*`, pin the producing investigation npz as a static input-SHA, and either reproduce the value bit-for-bit (the promotion gates: B1, CV2A) or run the one decisive new compute the rollup named (the decider gates: AS2, CCDARK2, CCDARK1, and the reduction leg of CF1).

**The six gates** (natural split per partition: the 3 HIGHEST | the 3 magnitude-decider HIGH):
- **S110-CF-B1-TRANSITPS** (transit-dynamics, HIGHEST) — promote TRANSIT-PS-67, shape AND amplitude together.
- **S110-CF-CV2A-MKK-TRANSMUT** (nazarewicz, HIGHEST) — promote the BCS M_KK transmutation PASS.
- **S110-CF1-AT-MINISUPERSPACE** (einstein, HIGHEST) — the a(t) backbone-form decider.
- **S110-CF-AS2-GREYBODY** (lizzi, HIGH) — A_s upper-edge dynamical near-horizon resonance scan.
- **S110-CF-CCDARK2-MU** (connes, HIGH) — the μ-discriminator (SA-as-free-energy R0 input).
- **S110-CF-CCDARK1-BBN** (volovik, HIGH) — non-thermal BBN-relief channel.

All six are COMPUTE-class (numerical PASS/FAIL/INFO threshold + producing script + verdict line; M1 of `wave-classification.md` fails the artifact-existence-only test, so none route to the methodology allowlist).

## Wave 2 Decision Point Prerequisites

W2 runs after W0 (Wave-0 hygiene) and the W1 workshops, but **no W2 gate is hard-blocked by a W1 verdict** — W1 gates close by artifact-existence (no verdict line), and the W2 deciders carry their own pre-registered thresholds independent of the workshop adjudications. Two SOFT couplings are documented (they shape interpretation, not dispatch):

- **S110-CF-AS2-GREYBODY** is informed by **WS-AS-1** (the A_s over-production epistemic-type adjudication) and by **WS-FLOQUET** (scheduled first; if inv-10 W2-4 wins, the "genuine over-production" reading weakens — `_rollup-as-wall §6`). AS2 itself adjudicates the *exit-filter* leg (substrate barrier vs fitted ∫Γ), which is orthogonal to the over-production-magnitude leg WS-AS-1 owns. AS2 runs regardless; its INFO/PASS/FAIL is well-defined on its own threshold.
- **S110-CF-CCDARK2-MU** is the **R0 prelude that gates WS-SA-FREE-ENERGY** (`_promotion-triage.md` Bucket-1 interlock 2): if the μ-scan converges (both ∂(vacuum)/∂μ and ∂(condensation)/∂V → zero), WS-SA-FREE-ENERGY collapses to housekeeping; if either is non-zero, the workshop fires. CCDARK2 therefore runs BEFORE that workshop, not after it; it has no W2-internal prerequisite.

Upstream investigation npz inputs (the static-SHA pins) are all confirmed on disk at plan-freeze (see the Input-SHA Ledger). If any input is missing at dispatch time, the gate honestly closes per `.claude/rules/mechanical-closure-discipline.md`.

## Wave 2 → Wave 3 Decision Point

W3 (M_KK-value + compact-object + Yukawa + d_s) consumes W2 outputs at three seams; W4 consumes one. Branching per W2 verdict:

- **S110-CF-CV2A-MKK-TRANSMUT → S110-CF-CV2B-GAUGE-A4 (W3).** CV2A lands the BCS-transmutation corridor PASS (Question A: derivation-in-principle); CV2B is the Question-B canonical-value discriminator (gauge-a₄ self-consistency, 3-way fork on 7.43e16 / 5.04e17 / ill-defined). If CV2A is **PASS**, CV2B runs as planned (the two are orthogonal — derivation-corridor vs canonical-value). If CV2A is **INFO** (cutoff-normalization rides), W3 flags that the canonical value is doubly-pending (Question A cutoff pin + Question B fork). The register status NOTE (M_KK keystone OPEN → transmutation-corridor PASS) lands only on CV2A PASS; HK-MKK stays "do not up-tag to derived."
- **S110-CF-B1-TRANSITPS → S110-CF-CV6B-DS-M4 (W3) + the deg(T_{BZ→pivot}) consumers.** B1 carries the deg(T_{BZ→pivot})=+2 scale-tag; CV6B is where deg(T_{BZ→pivot}) is DERIVED ONCE on the M⁴ summand (dedup flag iii). B1 CONSUMES the existing S93 W7-1 deg(T)=+2 value as a pin; CV6B (W3) is the fresh derivation on the M⁴ base. No circular dependency: B1 uses the canonical deg(T)=+2; CV6B re-derives it on the un-attacked M⁴ summand and either confirms or refines it (feeding CF3/CF-CO4 in W4).
- **S110-CF1-AT-MINISUPERSPACE → WS-CLOCKLOC + CF-INV4-W3-1-CLOCKLOC composition gate.** CF1 decides the a₄-grade functional form; WS-CLOCKLOC (W1) decides the a₀/a₂/a₄ clock-grade composition. If CF1 is **PASS(MONOTONE)**, the a₄ channel is a settled grade-input to the composition law. If CF1 is **INFO(SPLIT)**, the a₄-sign is scheme-dependent and WS-CLOCKLOC must carry that ambiguity into the composition verdict.
- **S110-CF-CCDARK2-MU → WS-SA-FREE-ENERGY (R0 gate) + atlas-04 S3 (HK-SA-RETAG, W0/W4).** CCDARK2 is the R0 prelude. **Reading-A (PASS, zero-on-both)** → WS-SA-FREE-ENERGY collapses to housekeeping; atlas-04 S3 down-scope to Layer-A confirmed (HK-SA-LAYER applies; HK-SA-RETAG to "SA=correct modulus action" stays gated). **Reading-B (FAIL, non-zero)** → WS-SA-FREE-ENERGY fires as a genuine workshop; CC-as-spectral-moment re-opens.
- **S110-CF-CCDARK1-BBN → WS-CC-H₀ (W1) + atlas-04 C10 (HK-C10).** CCDARK1 PASS → derived BBN relief (the cluster moves toward BOLSTERED); CCDARK1 FAIL → the BBN wall is the teeth of the CC↔H₀ exclusivity (WS-CC-H₀ consumes it as the tracking-freedom cost). HK-C10's "BBN-FALSIFIED-at-2.06×" tag holds unless CCDARK1 PASS supersedes it.

**Track-local boundary note** (`gate-verdicts.md §"Investigation-Track"`): the `inv{n}_*.npz` files are investigation-track artifacts; pinning them as static inputs to `s110_*` session gates is the SESSION-PROMOTION act — it lifts the investigation result into the session pipeline where it becomes index-visible. The session gate re-computes (B1/CV2A reproduce bit-for-bit; AS2/CCDARK1/CCDARK2/CF1 run the named decider), it does NOT merely cite the investigation verdict. **SHA-uniqueness reminder** (`agent-standards.md §"Completion Verification"` item 3): each gate's `audit_sha256` is computed at runtime from its ordered input-pin map (the `audit_sha256_inputs` list above) — never hardcoded. The six gates have distinct pin maps (distinct `gate_id` + distinct investigation npz), so their closure SHAs are pairwise distinct by construction (sig_5).
